findings.evidence: `SymmetricEnergy.lean:58` defines `lemma coefficientSymmetricPart_eq_self_of_isSymm`; the canonical coefficient symmetric-part block is `UniformEllipticity.lean:251-264` with `coefficientSymmetricPart`, `coefficientSymmetricPart_isSymm`, and `coefficientSymmetricPart_apply`.
findings.fix: Move this lemma to `TauCeti/Analysis/PDE/UniformEllipticity.lean` near `coefficientSymmetricPart`, `coefficientSymmetricPart_isSymm`, and `coefficientSymmetricPart_apply`; leave `SymmetricEnergy` to import/use it transitively through `EnergyForm`.
findings.issue: `coefficientSymmetricPart_eq_self_of_isSymm` is a generic matrix/coefficient fact, not an energy-integrand symmetry fact, so placing it in `SymmetricEnergy` hides broadly useful coefficient API behind the energy-form layer.

summary: One new declaration is in the wrong PDE layer: a generic coefficient symmetric-part lemma is placed in the energy-integrand symmetry file instead of the coefficient API file.
